scripts.pdf: npm run pdf:es && npm run pdf:va
scripts.pdf:es: astro build && npx starlight-to-pdf https://sergarb1.github.io/ApuntesProgramacion -p public/pdf -f ApuntesProgramacion-es --footer scripts/pdf-footer.html --header scripts/pdf-header.html --preceding-html scripts/pdf-cover.html --print-bg --exclude /va/
scripts.pdf:va: astro build && npx starlight-to-pdf https://sergarb1.github.io/ApuntesProgramacion/va/ -p public/pdf -f ApuntesProgramacion-va --footer scripts/pdf-footer.html --header scripts/pdf-header.html --preceding-html scripts/pdf-cover-va.html --print-bg
scripts.pdf:local:es: astro build && npx starlight-to-pdf http://localhost:4321/ApuntesProgramacion -p public/pdf -f ApuntesProgramacion-es --footer scripts/pdf-footer.html --header scripts/pdf-header.html --preceding-html scripts/pdf-cover.html --print-bg --exclude /va/
scripts.pdf:local:va: astro build && npx starlight-to-pdf http://localhost:4321/ApuntesProgramacion/va/ -p public/pdf -f ApuntesProgramacion-va --footer scripts/pdf-footer.html --header scripts/pdf-header.html --preceding-html scripts/pdf-cover-va.html --print-bg
scripts.epub:all: pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/generate-epub.ps1 -Lang es && pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/generate-epub.ps1 -Lang va
